paper_title: Paper Copilot A Self-Evolving and Efficient LLM System for Personalized   Academic Assistance
caption: Efficient deployment methods dramatically reduce the time cost. The average total time cost before efficient deployment is 87.1s (26.2s + 60.9s), which is reduced by 69.92% after efficient deployment.
model_annotation: The pie chart depicts the breakdown of an average total time cost into two categories related to efficient deployment, showing 2 slices in total. One slice is labeled “Efficient deployment,” colored blue, and is annotated inside the slice as 26.2s (30.08%). The other slice is labeled “Reduction,” colored orange, and is annotated as 60.9s (69.92%). The chart places the numeric value and percentage labels directly within each slice and does not show a separate legend; the slices are separated by a prominent white boundary, and the smaller blue segment appears slightly offset from the rest of the pie.
